title: A neural network estimates bone marrow adiposity from head MRI and maps its genetics
summary: An artificial neural network trained on simulated head types localized calvarial bone marrow in T1-weighted head MRI, giving an adiposity phenotype with sex-dimorphic age trajectories including a menopause effect. It showed high SNP and twin heritability and 41 genome-wide significant loci (6 sex-specific), plus genetic correlations with cognitive ability and Parkinson's disease. Test-retest of 30 individuals scanned 10 times and monozygotic twin concordance (0.91 male, 0.82 female pairs) were checked; loci were not experimentally validated and the genetics is correlational.
